name: Olivia Bennett
message: I have a throbbing toothache and my cheek has started swelling. I am struggling to sleep and need to know whether someone can see me today.
expected_reason: The patient reports significant pain and swelling and is asking for urgent same-day care.

name: Ethan Walker
message: I have already had a consultation elsewhere and decided to move forward with an implant. Could you tell me what records you need and whether I can schedule the first appointment this week?
expected_reason: The patient has decided to proceed with treatment and wants to arrange an appointment this week.

name: Sophia Carter
message: I have been comparing clear aligner options and would like to get started with a treatment plan. Do you have consultation appointments available next week?
expected_reason: The patient has moved beyond general research and is asking to book a consultation soon to begin treatment.

name: Mason Reed
message: Could you share the price for a standard cleaning and let me know whether you accept new patients? I may be able to come in sometime next month.
expected_reason: The person is interested and considering an appointment, but has no immediate need or firm booking plan.

name: Ava Mitchell
message: I am thinking about Invisalign and would like to understand the usual cost, payment plans, and how long treatment takes. I am not in a rush, but I would consider a consultation if the options fit my budget.
expected_reason: The patient shows genuine interest and may book after learning about cost and payment options, but is not ready to schedule yet.

name: Noah Foster
message: I have been considering veneers because I am unhappy with the shape of two front teeth. I would like to know whether I might be a candidate and what the process involves; I am probably looking at sometime later this year.
expected_reason: The patient has a specific cosmetic concern and is exploring treatment, but the timing is distant and no appointment is requested.

name: Isabella Brooks
message: One of my back teeth has been a little sensitive on and off for about two weeks. It is not painful right now, so I am unsure whether I should make an appointment or just keep an eye on it.
expected_reason: The recurring sensitivity may indicate a real need for care, but the patient is uncertain about booking and does not describe an urgent situation.

name: Lucas Gray
message: I am collecting prices from several clinics for teeth whitening. I only need the lowest quoted price for now and do not plan to schedule a visit.
expected_reason: The person is only comparing prices and explicitly says they do not intend to book an appointment.

name: Mia Richardson
message: Hello, I am looking for a receptionist position at your dental clinic. Could you tell me where to send my resume and whether you are currently hiring?
expected_reason: This is a job inquiry rather than a request for dental treatment.

name: James Cooper
message: I am preparing a school presentation about children's dental care and wanted to ask whether your clinic has a general information brochure. I am not looking to make an appointment.
expected_reason: The message is for an informational school project and explicitly has no patient or booking intent.
